text: Hey, I'm set up. Wonder when the plasma lab is. You built a robot? Yes, we did, Kripke.

text: Well, if you have any delusions about entering up against my robot, the Kripke Crippler, in the Southern California Robot Fighting League Round Robin Invitational, AKA the SCRFLOOI, his name is gonna be Scrap Metal. Come on, is that really necessary?

text: Kripke, your robot is inferior. And it will be defeated by ours, because ours exceeds yours in both design and execution. Also, I'm given to understand that your mother is overweight.
